name: OA.Report
tagline: Track Open Access policy compliance and research openness across funded publications
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on third-party data sources (OpenAlex, Crossref)

news_articles.headline: Confused by open-access policies? These tools can help

academic_citations.title: From policy to practice: Lessons learned from an open science funding initiative

policy_outcomes.description: Enables research funders to measure and enforce Open Access policy compliance across their funded research portfolios

outcome_methodology: Observational tracking of Open Access compliance rates across funder portfolios using bibliographic data integration
documented_limitations: Coverage limited to publications indexed in OpenAlex and Crossref
Relies on accurate funder metadata in publication records
May not capture all open access variants (green, gold, hybrid)
jurisdictional_scope: International, primarily serving major research funders in US and UK
failure_modes: Data quality issues from upstream sources
Incomplete funder attribution in publication metadata
curation_criteria: Tracks publications linked to funded research through funder identifiers and grant metadata
